source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1964, p. 2 ("Taylor-Nobbs' success: Castlereagh"); Belfast Telegraph, 11 June 1964, p. 13 ("Castlereagh Rural District Council: notice of result")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: The Castlereagh results report read in the Belfast News-Letter of 5 June 1964; Dundonald and Gilnahirk counts from the returning officer's notice in the Belfast Telegraph of 11 June 1964. Names and votes read on the BNA image of the returning officer's notice (council-audit, Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of Castlereagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Seven of the nine divisions were contested, Craigavad and Holywood returning unopposed. The counts for Dundonald and Gilnahirk are not printed in the report read and those divisions are omitted.
correctionNote: Checked on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 11 June 1964, p. 13 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the returning officer's notice prints WILSON, Wilfred Samuel 1,099 (elected) and MULLIGAN, Bruce R. 1,089, as filed; the notice is now cited first (the names are not on the cited News-Letter page).
